TarokZa2 — slovenski tarok za dva. Ustva: TarokZa2 — Slovenian tarok for two. Create a table, invite a friend and enjoy your next game.
22 tarokov in po 8 kart vsake barve. Pri: 22 trumps and 8 cards of each suit, shown from highest to lowest.
Figure so kralj, dama, kaval in fant. V: The court cards are king, queen, knight and jack. Hearts and diamonds also have 1, 2, 3 and 4; spades and clubs have 10, 9, 8 and 7.

Dva igralca, 54 kart in 27 štihov. Cilj: Two players, 54 cards and 27 tricks. Collect at least 36 of the 70 card points to win.
Najprej karte. Vsak dobi 15 kart v roko: Deal the cards. Each player gets 15 cards in hand and three face-down piles of four cards. The non-dealer bids first.
Igram ali naprej? Z »Igram« napoveš zmag: Play or pass? Choose “I play” to announce that you will win. If both players choose “Pass”, play an normal game.
Odpri kupčke. Po napovedi se vrhnje kart: Reveal the piles. After bidding, the top cards turn face up. You may take a trump or king into your hand or leave it on the pile. Choose “Take into hand” beside the pile for each card. You can do this later, including during your opponent’s turn. The next card is revealed and you decide separately whether to take it. Picking up a card does not use your turn.
Začni igro. Po izbiri »Igram« ali dveh »: Start playing. After “I play” or two passes, you can play the first card immediately. The non-dealer leads.
Sledi barvi. Upoštevajo se tudi odprte k: Follow suit. Face-up pile cards count too. If you have no card of the led suit, you must play a trump; if you have neither, you may play any card. You do not have to play a higher card.
Začni iz roke. Karto s kupčka lahko pril: Lead from your hand. You can play a pile card in response to your opponent’s card. You may only lead from a pile when your hand is empty. The higher trump, or higher card of the led suit, wins the trick.
Šteje razlika od 35 točk. Napovedana zma: Use the difference from 35 card points. An announced win scores the difference × 2. An announced loss scores the shortfall × −3. In an normal game, the winner scores the difference × 1. A 35–35 tie scores 0.
Vsi štirje kralji ali cela trula v tvoji: Winning all four kings or the complete trula in your tricks scores +10. Holding them in your hand is not enough. Valat means winning all 27 tricks: +250. Valat replaces the basic game, kings and trula scores. Mondfang: if the Sküs captures your Mond, you score −21, even with a valat.
Štetje: od vsote vrednosti vsake trojice: Counting: subtract 2 from the total value of each group of three cards; subtract 1 for one or two leftover cards. Trula cards and kings are worth 5 each, queens 4, knights 3, jacks 2 and all other cards 1. There are no doubles, radelci or ultimo announcements. Announcements are final. If both players announce valat, each scores +500 or −500 according to their own result. Bonuses follow the agreed TarokZa2 rules.
